description:
At i360technologies, we deliver business consulting and technology solutions that support the mission of federal agencies. A major federal agency is consolidating its core financial management systems into a single, multi-tenant Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP solution as part of the government-wide push to standardize federal financial management. The program will migrate multiple agency components and customer agencies onto the new platform, with a stated goal of making maximum use of automation and artificial intelligence to reduce manual workload, speed reconciliation and improve data quality.

 i360technologies supports this program as a subcontractor to a large federal systems integrator. We are seeking an Oracle Analytics FDI Developer who will help build the financial dashboards and reports the agency uses to see its data clearly and track performance. Centralizing financial data and improving reporting and analytics is a core goal of the program. This is an entry-level role: if you're curious about data, learn fast, and want to start your career on a program of this size, this role is built for you.

 Location: Washington, DC Metro, on-site at client facilities; occasional travel to other client locations.

 Why AI Matters Here

 AI is central to how this team delivers. We want developers who already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to learn new platforms quickly, write and debug SQL, build visualizations, check data, and document their work. You don't need years of experience. You do need to show us how you've used AI to learn something new and get real results.

 What You Will Do

 
 Help develop Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) dashboards, visualizations, and analytical content.

 Support configuration of financial subject areas and semantic models.

 Help build KPIs and performance metrics.

 Write and test SQL queries.

 Help integrate Fusion ERP data into analytics solutions.

 Validate financial data and reporting accuracy.

 Support dashboard and query performance tuning.

 Support security and role-based access to analytics.

 Support testing, deployment, and production support.

 Document your work and learn from senior developers on the team.

 
 Required Qualifications

 
 High school diploma.

 1year of experience required.

 Knowledge of SQL through coursework, projects, or work.

 Knowledge of or hands-on experience with a data visualization or BI tool (Oracle Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).

 Basic understanding of data modeling or databases.

 Interest in financial data and reporting.

 Demonstrated use of AI tools to learn new technologies and get work done.

 
 What You'll Gain

 
 A start to your career on a decade-long federal modernization program.

 Mentorship from senior Oracle analytics and federal financial management specialists.

 A career path that grows with the program: more scope, more responsibility, more expertise each year.

 In-demand skills in Oracle analytics, SQL, and AI-enabled delivery.

 
 What Success Looks Like

 
 Assigned dashboards, queries, and reports are built and checked on schedule.

 The data you deliver is accurate and ties to the source.

 You learn FDI and Fusion data quickly, using AI to accelerate learning, and take on more scope over time.

 
 Security & Eligibility Requirements

 
 US Citizenship or Lawful Permanent Residency with a minimum of three (3) years of U.S. residency

 Successful completion of a Moderate Risk background investigation and FBI fingerprinting

 Eligibility to obtain and maintain an HSPD-12 Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential

 Execution of a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)

 Compliance with agency Security Rules of Behavior

 Completion of required cybersecurity and privacy awareness training

 Work must be performed within the United States (remote access from foreign locations is not permitted)

 Employment is contingent upon contract award and Government approval of candidate qualifications

 
 Benefits

 
 Referral Bonus

 (401k) Matching

 Holidays – Eleven

 Technology Reimbursement

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

 Paid Time Off (0-3 years - 15 Days PTO | 3+ years 20 Days)

 80% Employer Paid Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

 
 Benefit eligibility and coverage are subject to applicable plan terms and company policies. 

 Location: Washington, DC Metro. On-site at client facilities in the DC Metro area as required; occasional travel to other client locations 

 Equal Opportunity Employer Minority/Female/Veteran/Disability
